current_evidence: The live Local Information Requirements page says the list was 'reviewed and consulted on between 24th January 2025 and 21st February 2025 and adopted on 28th March 2025', and a search found no later review.

issues.detail: List date is recorded as 2025-03-01, but the page gives the adoption date as 28 March 2025. Grokbot's own Date basis quotes '28th March 2025', so the date should be 2025-03-28.
issues.evidence: "reviewed and consulted on between 24th January 2025 and 21st February 2025 and adopted on 28th March 2025"

issues.detail: Several general (non-Welborne) local requirements are not captured anywhere. (1) Access Statement: major full/outline where a Public Right of Way near the site may be affected. (2) Climate Change Statement: major full/outline/reserved matters, covering policies CC2, CC3, CC4, NE1, NE2, NE6, NE9, NE10 and D4. (3) CIL Form 2 (Assumption of Liability): householder, minor, major, s73, outline and RM, for any chargeable development. (4) Landscape Assessment and Enhancement Scheme: major full/outline/RM on sites in areas of special landscape quality. (5) Minerals Safeguarding Assessment: major full/outline within a Minerals Safeguarding Area. (6) Obligations Summary: full/outline where planning contributions are needed under the Local Plan and Planning Obligations SPD. (7) Open Space Assessment: full (including change of use) and outline on existing public open space. (8) Refuse and Recycling Plan: detailed residential full applications (including change of use). (9) Self and Custom Build Checklist: full/outline/RM/change of use, for a net increase of 40+ dwellings. (10) Self and Custom Build Statement and Biodiversity Information: sites of up to 9 dwellings / 0.5 ha made up only of self-build homes.
issues.evidence: Fareham Local Information Requirements page headings: Access Statement; Climate Change Statement; CIL Form 2; Landscape Assessment and Enhancement Scheme; Minerals Safeguarding Assessment; Obligations Summary; Open Space Assessment; Refuse and Recycling Plan; Self and Custom Build Checklist; Self and Custom Build Statement and Biodiversity Information

issues.detail: The Welborne section of the list is almost entirely missing, and only Energy Strategy was captured. The Welborne-only requirements that are missing are: Compliance Statement (all Welborne RM, against outline P/17/0266/OA), Comprehensive Masterplans, Welborne Ecological Assessment, Employment and Training Plan, Welborne FRA with SuDS strategy, Framework Travel Plan, Heritage Strategy, Infrastructure Delivery Plan, Landscaping Scheme (Structural), Open Space and Green Infrastructure Strategy, Phasing Plan, Site Wide Viability Assessment (where infrastructure is reduced or delayed), Strategic Design Codes / Design Principles, Structuring Plan (incl. parameter plans), Transport Framework with Public Transport Plan, and Waste Water Strategy (all Welborne applications).
issues.evidence: Welborne table: 'apply to residential, commercial and community applications within the Welborne boundary, in addition to the above'

issues.detail: Several requirements are missing from application types the source names. Drainage Strategy applies to all major applications, and also to householder, full and outline applications in a critical drainage area. Flood Risk Assessment applies to householder (ground-floor development in Flood Zones 2/3) and to major full/outline. Ecological Assessment applies to householder, full and outline. Habitat Regulations Supporting Statement applies to full, outline and RM. Heritage Statement applies to full, outline, full with LBC and LBC. Ventilation/Extraction Report applies to full (including change of use) and to RM for layout/appearance. Parking Provision applies to RM for layout. Playing Field Checklist applies to outline. Grokbot put most of these only under Full planning, as INFERRED rows. As a result Householder lacks FRA and Drainage, Outline lacks FRA/Drainage/Ecology/HRA/Heritage/Playing Field, RM lacks HRA/Parking/Ventilation, and LBC lacks Heritage Statement.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Flood Risk Assessment - Householder; full and outline for major'; 'Heritage Statement - Full, outline, full with LBC, LBC'; 'Habitat Regulations Supporting Statement - Full, outline, RM'

issues.detail: Some requirements are placed under application types the source does not apply them to. Space Standards Checklist and Retail Impact Assessment are under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the source means change of use planning applications ('Full planning applications (including change of use)'), not prior approvals. Tree Survey is under 'Works to trees', but the source requires it only for householder, full and outline applications. Contamination Assessment is under 'Minerals & waste (county)', but Fareham is a district and the source applies it to major full/outline. Archaeological DBA is under 'Listed building consent', but the source says 'Full planning application with listed building consent'.
issues.evidence: Space Standards: 'Full planning applications Reserved Matter applications Change of use applications'; Tree Survey: 'Householder applications Full planning applications Outline planning applications'

issues.detail: Many rows (about 15) are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' with generic fragments instead of the list's own 'Required for' text, even though every heading on the Fareham page states its application types. Examples are Design and Access Statement, Environmental Statement, Floor plans/Elevations, Nutrient Neutrality, Viability Assessment, Ventilation/Extraction, Heritage Statement and Open space.
issues.evidence: Every Fareham heading carries a 'Required for the following types of applications:' line

issues.detail: Several triggers are wrong or meaningless. Drainage Strategy uses foul-sewage text ('fuller foul drainage assessment will be required...') instead of the critical drainage area trigger. Flood Risk Assessment uses 'The FRA should form part of an environmental statement when one is required...', which leaves out the Flood Zone 2/3 and 1 ha triggers. Habitats Regulations row is the fragment 'measures), an appropriate assessment is required.' and leaves out the trigger 'net increase in overnight accommodation'. Ecological row under Householder is a fragment of the Hampshire checklist ('Amphibians (particularly with respect to great crested newts) 3.4...'). Viability row is cut off ('compliant, then a viability assessment...').
issues.evidence: Drainage Strategy: 'Site within a critical drainage area'; HRA statement: 'Net increase in overnight accommodation'

issues.detail: Some thresholds are left out or cut off. Affordable Housing Statement has no threshold, but the source requires it for 10+ units, sites of 0.5 ha+, allocated housing sites, or larger parcels that could take 10+ units. Travel Plan stops at 'subject to following thresholds ( National Planning Policy Framework ):', so the numbers are lost (residential 100 units; B1/B2 2,500 sqm; B8 5,000 sqm; retail 1,000 sqm; care 500 sqm or 5 bedrooms, etc.). CIL Form 1 is cut off before the trigger (residential/retail over 100 sqm, or any new dwelling).
issues.evidence: Travel Plan thresholds table on the Fareham page; Affordable Housing: 'Residential of 10+ units, site of 0.5 ha or more'

issues.detail: Energy / Sustainability Statement is shown as a general Full planning requirement, but the source requires the Energy Strategy only for Welborne applications. The Welborne-only scope is lost.
issues.evidence: "Energy Strategy Required for: All planning application(s) for Welborne."

issues.detail: The HRA tab item is garbled. It joins the New Forest contribution bullet and the 10-year land-use chronology bullet into one sentence ('...see the report to the Executive Confirmation of the way in which the site has been used during the 10 years...'). The noise trigger is filed under 'all application types' with no requirement name, but Noise Assessment applies only to major full/outline.
issues.evidence: Habitat Regulations Supporting Statement bullets; 'Noise Assessment Required for the following types of *major applications: Full planning applications Outline planning applications'

issues.detail: Several tab items are guidance, boilerplate or fragments rather than requirements. They are: 'Although not a requirement of legislation, the inclusion of a linear scale bar is also useful...' (Sport England guidance); 'It also provides direct support and advice to a number of local authorities... Consultations should be sent by email to Sport England's planning administration team' (Sport England process text); 'For further information relating to self and custom build see the Fareham Self and Custom Build SPD'; 'For information relating to the detailed access and refuse storage requirements see the Refuse Storage Design Guidance'; 'SAC = Special Area of Conservation and SPA = Special Protection Area' (definition); '2km of a SAC, SPA or Ramsar site' (fragment); 'YES/NO SECTION 1 - Designated Sites and Habitats Please answer ALL questions...' (form questions); and 'The self and custom build checklist must include:' (cut off with no content).
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules', 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'

issues.detail: Some app-type rows are incidental phrases, not local requirements. Design and Access Statement is 'in the design and access statement, if required.' Environmental Statement is 'This information might form part of an environmental statement, where one is necessary.' Floor plans/Elevations is a sentence about street sections. None of these is a Fareham local list item.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning: Design and Access Statement, Environmental Statement (EIA), Floor plans / Elevations

issues.detail: Some items were taken from documents other than the Fareham list and presented as Fareham requirements: Sport England's Playing Fields Policy and Guidance (Dec 2021, national), and Hampshire County Council's generic biodiversity checklist .docx files. The Householder Biodiversity Checklist, Ecological and HRA rows come from the county checklist form, not from the Fareham list's own triggers.
issues.evidence: docs_read: sportengland-production-files...Playing Fields Policy and Guidance; documents.hants.gov.uk/biodiversity/BiodiversityChecklisthouseholdersapp.docx

issues.detail: Overlapping rows under Full planning describe the same requirement. 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' are both Ecological Assessment text. 'Nutrient Neutrality' and 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' are both parts of the single Habitat Regulations Supporting Statement. 'Affordable Housing Statement' and 'Viability Assessment' come from the same Affordable Housing paragraph.
issues.evidence: Fareham page has a single 'Habitat Regulations Supporting Statement' heading including Bird Aware, New Forest, land-use chronology and Nutrient Budget

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Fareham list (adopted 28 March 2025), but the date is slightly wrong (recorded as 1 March). The extraction is weak: about 10 general requirements and almost all 17 Welborne items are missing, many rows are INFERRED to Full planning only with garbled or fragment triggers, and several tab items are Sport England or Hampshire boilerplate rather than Fareham requirements.
